notes: All three pages are actually the same listings index page (the detail page HTML was not included — each URL loaded the browse/index page instead). All fields appear inside .bfs-specs divs within each .bfs-row card. Asking Price, Cash Flow, and Total Sales (gross revenue) each use a consistent label pattern: a <span> with the label text followed by a sibling <span> with the value, inside .bfs-specs. Use label method: find the <span> whose text equals the label, then take the immediately following sibling <span> for the value. City and state are combined in a single <span> (e.g. 'Lawrence, Kansas' or just 'Kansas') that is the third <span> child inside the row content div, after the badge and before .bfs-specs — there is no separate city/state split in the HTML. The CSS selector above targets that location span; callers must parse city and state from its text content. Some listings show only a state with no city. Cash flow is sometimes 'Not disclosed' or 'N/A', which are displayed values, not true non-disclosure at the broker level — the broker does publish the field when available, so not_disclosed is false.
